package: @astryxdesign/lab

# ChatEmojiPicker

popover emoji grid on a trigger button; shortname filter + 8-col arrow-key nav; onSelect closes + restores focus; DEFAULT_CHAT_EMOJIS overridable

**Import:** `import {ChatEmojiPicker} from '@astryxdesign/lab';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `onSelect` | `(emoji: string) => void` | - | (emoji)=>void; closes popover **(required)** |
| `emojis` | `readonly {emoji: string; name: string}[]` | `DEFAULT_CHAT_EMOJIS` | {emoji,name}[] grid options, 8/row; name drives filter + aria |
| `label` | `string` | `'Pick an emoji'` | popover dialog aria label |
| `searchLabel` | `string` | `'Search emoji'` | filter input placeholder + hidden label |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | trigger element containing a button **(required)** |
